items.title: Morgan Stanley says it is among the first banks to tokenize real world assets
items.summary: The bank's announcement follows the launch of the Depository Trust &amp; Clearing Corporation’s Tokenization Service, or DTS, on Oct. 28.

items.title: Zcash grants committee drops plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC to future mining rewards
items.summary: The committee withdrew its proposal after community backlash, leaving competing plans to cut off its funding or preserve the existing grants system.

items.title: Bitcoin surges to $78,300 in V-shaped comeback as midterm election uncertainty fades
items.summary: BTC is steaming higher as U.S. midterm election uncertainty fades.

items.title: Jack Dorsey's Block faces $764 million DOJ settlement as bitcoin profit plunges 50%
items.summary: The proposed agreement would resolve a federal anti-money-laundering investigation, while lower Cash App trading fees halved Block's quarterly bitcoin gross profit.

items.title: U.S.-sanctioned Moscow Exchange to list bitcoin and Tether’s USDT in December
items.summary: Russia’s main bourse wants back the crypto trading Russians do abroad, and one of the coins it's listing is issued by a company that freezes wallets on the U.S. sanctions list.

items.title: South Korea's ruling party wants to delay its crypto tax again
items.summary: South Korea's ruling party wants to delay crypto tax by about two years, as it waits for global tax-sharing rules and new digital assets law.

items.title: Democrats surge toward Senate, House majorities, with crypto braced for new direction
items.summary: The dominance of Republicans in all three government branches has been broken by the midterms, and the industry will feel the result as Congress changes hands.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly sinks to $75,700 as bets on a Democratic sweep rattle markets
items.summary: Stock futures and the dollar slid and Treasuries rallied as early U.S. midterm returns pointed to Democrats taking both chambers of Congress.

items.title: Live updates: Crypto's election gamble falters as Democratic victories usher in a 'blue wave'
items.summary: Voters are choosing who will represent them in the House, Senate and state-wide seats.

items.title: What voters said about their views on crypto
items.summary: A CoinDesk-commissioned poll from April sheds light on how voters — who aren't necessarily part of the crypto sector — view this industry.

items.title: Justin Sun seeks $264K sanctions over World Liberty’s UAE disclosure
items.summary: Sun plans to refile his token-freeze lawsuit in California state court after the sanctions motion is resolved. A hearing is set for Dec. 10.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1.16B as Bitwise calls selling ‘short-term’
items.summary: Bitwise’s André Dragosch attributed Bitcoin ETF outflows to weaker market sentiment, saying institutions have largely maintained their exposure.

items.title: US midterm elections 2026 as it happened: Democrats win control of Congress
items.summary: Democrats won control of Congress in the 2026 US midterms. Catch up on key races, crypto-backed candidates and the outlook for crypto regulation.

items.title: Binance hackers move 81% of stolen Solana, route funds via THORChain
items.summary: The Binance attackers moved most of the stolen SOL and continued laundering funds through THORChain after the protocol resumed swaps.

items.title: Democrats win US House to secure control of Congress in midterms
items.summary: Democrats will take control of House committees in January 2027, giving them power to investigate President Donald Trump’s administration.

items.title: Bitcoin bounces from 7-week low under $76K as Democrats sweep Congress
items.summary: Bitcoin price downside reached a seven-week-low of $75,618 as 24-hour crypto long liquidations neared $300 million.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Ethereum dev targets 2028 for quantum resistance, a year early
items.summary: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake said it is their “hope” that Ethereum will achieve its post-quantum and post-AI transition by December 2028.

items.title: Democrats claim control of the US Senate
items.summary: The shift in Senate control could change the path for the CLARITY Act, reshape committee leadership and bring closer scrutiny of Trump’s crypto businesses.

items.title: ZachXBT identifies French bank as alleged victim of $133M crypto theft
items.summary: The French bank has not confirmed its alleged involvement in the crypto theft, which ZachXBT said could have resulted in losses exceeding $133 million.

items.title: Judge Orders Bitcoin Wallet Returned to Family of Convicted Canadian Killer
items.summary: A Nova Scotia judge found prosecutors failed to link William Sandeson's Bitcoin to the 2015 murder of fellow student Taylor Samson.

items.title: OpenAI Wants to Rebrand AI Data Centers, Use Them to 'Protect the Grid'
items.summary: The ChatGPT maker says future facilities could ease pressure on power grids by cutting demand during emergencies.

items.title: Tether Holds 150,000 Bitcoin, CEO Says—About 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Shows
items.summary: Paolo Ardoino told the Plan ₿ Forum in Lugano the company owns “give or take 150,000 Bitcoin,” but its Q3 reserve report implies just 100,060.

items.title: Anthropic's AI Is Getting Cheaper to Use. That's Becoming a Problem for Its Business
items.summary: Claude's prices are falling, but Anthropic's computing expenses grew faster than sales in the latest quarter—a tricky equation ahead of its IPO.

items.title: CrowdStrike Launches AI Agent 'Kill Switch,' Plans to Acquire Fiddler AI
items.summary: CrowdStrike's new kill switch lets security teams cut off unauthorized AI agents through a gateway, while its planned Fiddler acquisition aims to make autonomous software easier to monitor and audit.

items.title: Justin Sun Accuses Trump-Backed World Liberty of Using UAE Ties to Escape Federal Court
items.summary: Tron founder Justin Sun said he has asked a federal court to sanction World Liberty Financial, alleging the Trump family-backed venture delayed disclosing UAE ties that could defeat federal jurisdiction over his lawsuit.

items.title: Crypto Docs Host GitBook Hit by AI Agent Security Breach, Urges Users to Rotate Keys
items.summary: GitBook says attackers accessed infrastructure credentials in an AI-assisted breach, prompting a shutdown and emergency token resets.

items.title: CFTC Lets Traders Bet on Stocks With Crypto-Style Perpetual Futures
items.summary: Chairman Michael Selig said “equity perpetual futures” can now trade on CFTC-registered exchanges, extending a crypto-native instrument to traditional stocks.

items.title: Brazil's Biggest Bitcoin Exchange Says It Will Refund Users After a $40 Million Hack
items.summary: Mercado Bitcoin says customers won't pay for a hack that drained tens of millions. Withdrawals on the exchange remain frozen with no restart date.

items.title: Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Block Their Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Venue
items.summary: Amazon, Tesla, SpaceX, Netflix, Lam Research, and SoFi objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 56.
